+ Privacy policy +

+
+ +

+ The site is operated by Daan Vrieling, based in the + Netherlands. For privacy questions, email{' '} + + contact@zvapor.xyz + + . +

+ + + +

I only collect information needed to run this site.

+
    +
  • + + Contact form. + {' '} + If you send a message, I receive your name, email address, + and message. That content is emailed to me. It is not saved + in the website database. +
    • +
  • + + Abuse prevention. + {' '} + The contact form is rate limited. Your IP address and email + address are used as short-lived keys so the form cannot be + flooded. Those keys expire after the limit window (one hour + by default). +
    • +
  • + + Performance and page views. + {' '} + The site uses Vercel Speed Insights and Vercel Web + Analytics. Those services receive technical data such as + the page URL, referrer, country, browser, device type, and + performance timings. They are not used to build an + advertising profile. +
    • +
  • + + Hosting logs. + {' '} + The host (Vercel) may log requests, including IP address + and user agent, to operate and secure the site. +
    • +
+ + + +

+ The public site does not set marketing or account cookies. + Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights run without cookies. + Signing in to the CMS at{' '} + /admin{' '} + sets a session cookie for that login only. Visitors do not + need an account to read the site or use the contact form. +

+ + + +

+ I process contact details so I can reply to you. I process IP + addresses and rate-limit keys to keep the form usable. I + process performance and page-view data to see whether pages + load properly and which pages are used. + Under the GDPR, that is based on steps you take when you ask + me to contact you, and on my legitimate interest in running + and protecting the site. +

+ + + +

I use a few processors to host and deliver the site:

+
    +
  • Vercel — hosting, Speed Insights, and Web Analytics.
    • +
  • + The site mail server — delivery of contact-form messages. +
    • +
  • + Upstash — short-lived rate-limit keys, when that service is + configured. Otherwise those keys stay in server memory and + are discarded when the instance goes cold. +
    • +
  • + Neon — the database for CMS content and admin accounts, not + for messages you send through the contact form. +
    • +
+

+ Some project images load from GitHub or Imgur. Those services + receive your IP address when your browser requests the image. + Links to GitHub, X, npm, and other sites are third parties + with their own policies. +

+

+ Some of these providers are outside the European Economic + Area. Where they transfer personal data, they do so under + their own safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses. +

+ + + +

+ I keep contact emails for as long as I need them to handle + your message and any follow-up, then delete them. Rate-limit + keys expire automatically with the limit window. Hosting and + performance data are kept according to those providers’ + retention periods. +

+ + + +

+ If you are in the EEA or UK, you can ask for access, + correction, deletion, or a copy of your personal data, and + you can object to or restrict processing based on legitimate + interests. Email{' '} + + contact@zvapor.xyz + + . You can also lodge a complaint with the Dutch data + protection authority, the{' '} + + Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens + + . +

+ + + +

+ This site is not directed at children, and I do not knowingly + collect personal data from anyone under 16. +

+ Terms of use +

+
+ +

+ You can browse this portfolio for personal, non-commercial + use. Do not misuse it: no attempts to break, scrape in a way + that degrades the service, or interfere with the contact form + or the CMS. +

+ + + +

+ Text, design, and original project material on this site + belong to Daan Vrieling unless a project page says otherwise. + You may share links to the site. You may not copy the design + or republish the content as your own. Third-party names, + logos, and linked projects remain the property of their + owners. +

+ + + +

+ Use the form for genuine messages. Do not send unlawful, + abusive, or unsolicited bulk messages. I may ignore or block + messages that look like spam. Sending a message means I can + use the details you provide to reply, as described in the + privacy policy. +

+ + + +

+ The site is a personal portfolio. Project descriptions are + informational. Nothing here is professional, legal, or + technical advice, and nothing creates a client relationship + until we agree to one separately. The site is provided as is, + without a promise that it will always be available or + error-free. +

+ + + +

+ To the extent Dutch law allows, I am not liable for damage + that comes from using the site, relying on its content, or + following a link to another website. This does not limit + liability that cannot legally be limited. +

+ + + +

+ These terms are governed by the laws of the Netherlands. If + you and I cannot resolve a dispute, the courts of the + Netherlands have jurisdiction, without limiting rights you + have as a consumer where you live. +
